records.name: na2b:leases-not-cleared
records.why: release_pool runs only once every lease of the pool is inactive and not pending (destroy needs !live && !outstanding; a definite or local refusal precedes any accept), and prepare rewrites .pool while accept rewrites the token, so the clear is hygiene only.

records.name: na2b:idle-ignores-request-cells
records.why: every used request cell holds a fixed handle (read-drop-keeps-cell is the mutant that separates them), so the ring is not idle while a cell is used.

records.name: na2b:executor-release-without-zero
records.why: create zeroes the storage, and a stale managed drop after release already fails cell->driver&&!cell->retiring, since the first drop set retiring.
